standard.note: Public Act 19-4 indexed Connecticut to the federal Employment Cost Index from 2024; $16.35 in 2025, $16.94 in 2026.

tipped.note: Connecticut runs TWO tipped rates, split by occupation rather than by employer: hotel and restaurant staff at a $6.38 cash wage, bartenders at $8.71. Both are frozen dollar figures, so every ECI increase lands entirely on the tip credit.

variants.label: Bartender cash wage
variants.test: An employee who customarily and regularly receives tips while working as a bartender.
variants.note: Conn. Gen. Stat. 31-60(b) sets a separate, smaller tip credit for bartenders.
